React concurrent rendering and interruptible
work

React can schedule some rendering work with different priorities and may abandon or restart work before
commit. Render logic must remain pure.
React එකට සමහර renders pause කරන්න Jහහෝ restart කරන්න පුළුවන්. ඒ නිසා render එක ඇතුJළේ
Typing interrupts a lower-priority expensive search render.
Nonurgent render begins Urgent input update Work may restart Commit chosen result
Read the diagram: Intermediate render work is not guaranteed to commit; external changes belong outside render.
Expected result: The function computes UI without mutating the input; repeated renders remain safe.

Interview question: Why must render be pure?
Answer: React may call it multiple times or discard work; side effects would be unreliable.
Practice: Remove a mutation of props from a render function.
